subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: For this reason-aware generated-media wake-false fallback, is the skipped internal-path Mantis artifact plus scheduler matrix enough proof, or should this wait for stacked live Telegram/gateway proof?

options.title: Require Stacked Live Proof
